title: Regulatory Compliance and TRAI Disclosure Policy
content:
Regulatory Compliance and TRAI Disclosure Policy

Document ID: Policy_C28_regulatory_compliance

Category: C28 — Regulatory & Compliance (TRAI)

Department: Legal

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

1. Purpose

Describes NovaTel's commitment to compliance with applicable telecom regulatory requirements, including tariff transparency, Quality of Service (QoS) reporting, and consumer protection rules.

2. Policy Statements

Quarterly QoS metrics are published on the NovaTel website's Regulatory Disclosures section.

DND/UCC, MNP, and KYC processes are implemented in line with the applicable TRAI regulations in force.

This policy is reviewed whenever a material regulatory change is notified by TRAI or the Department of Telecommunications.
